question: What kind of person turns the Kula scripture into a mere mockery?
premises: A seeker driven by greed is described.
Such a person is fickle and constant in that fickleness.
This behavior mocks the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of capalā is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
